system.description:
Smoke: You create a puff of black smoke in front of you for just a moment, breaking LoS with your target for just a moment before you make your attack, if you had LoS on them before this smoke appeared, you can now attack without needing LoS. You have a -3 to Attack Rolls but your opponent is Staggered against this Attack. If you use Smoke right after using Mirrors, your Attack Roll has a -1 instead.

Mirrors: You cause your image to ripple and warp and then put on a burst of speed. Choose a point within 2 spaces and move there in an instant without expending movement. Roll an Attack Roll with a +2, on a hit you deal half damage. If you use Mirrors right after using Smoke, your attack roll becomes a +4 instead.
